issue_context.analysis: The search control may synthesize a Ctrl-based shortcut that becomes Win-based after remapping. Correlate injected flags, original key events and shell activation before deciding whether input-origin handling needs correction; do not assume a mouse-button remap or discard every injected event.

reproduce.expected: Clicking Task Manager search should focus search without unexpected shell activation; physical modifier remapping must remain correct.
steps: On a test Windows system configure only Left Ctrl to Left Win, open Task Manager, and click its search box without pressing a keyboard key.
Record physical versus injected key events around the click, and compare Keyboard Manager disabled, remap enabled and right-side modifier controls.
If a generated Ctrl shortcut is transformed, isolate its origin and delivery ordering; verify any correction preserves physical remapping, accessibility input and intentional synthetic shortcuts.
